_comment: Quest chain, decided by the authority (SimAuthority quest_event). Generated by server/tools/gen_quests.py - edit the table there and re-run. One linear chain, two quests per level 1-50. `level`: the quest waits (nothing counts) until the player reaches it. Types: talk (target = NPC name, within talk_radius), kill (target = mob species from its scene; `boss` counts only boss kills), dummy (hits on a training dummy), equip (target = equipment slot), refine (a successful refinement), enchant (a successful imbue), monolith, dungeon (target = dungeons.json id, the run completes), enter_map (target = map id), visit (target = a place below; `mounted` requires the broom). Rewards: reward_exp (a share of the level's experience threshold by size), reward_gold, reward_house_rep, reward_items [{id, amount}] (bag, or a personal chest at the player's feet when it is full). Progress persists in the character's `quests` object (active, progress, done); the active quest is the first one not in `done`.

chapters.title: First Year
chapters.desc: Settle in at Hogwarts: your cloak, your first spells, your first broom.

chapters.title: The Forest Edge
chapters.desc: The creatures at the forest edge grow bolder; learn the forge and the trial.

chapters.title: Roads to Hogsmeade
chapters.desc: Snatchers prowl the roads; the village needs a wand it can trust.

chapters.title: Crypts and Trolls
chapters.desc: Something stirs in the crypts and the trolls come down from their hollow.

chapters.title: Barrows and Webs
chapters.desc: The dead rise in the barrows and the Matriarch spins in her hollow.

chapters.title: The Moors
chapters.desc: Trolls and dark wizards hold the moors above Hogsmeade.

chapters.title: The Forbidden Corridor
chapters.desc: The third-floor corridor is out of bounds - and something guards it.

chapters.title: Stone and Storm
chapters.desc: Mountain trolls gather under Grak at the Stone Circle Summit.

chapters.title: The Long Mist
chapters.desc: Dementors drift in from the shore; only a Patronus will hold them back.

chain.title: First-Year Orientation
chain.name: Speak with Professor Fig by the fountain
chain.desc: Professor Fig waits beside the courtyard fountain (gold ! marker). Walk up and click to talk.

chain.title: Dressed for the Grounds
chain.name: Wear the Woolen Traveller's Cloak
chain.desc: Open your bag with I and right-click the cloak Professor Fig gave you. It costs a little speed and buys a lot of armour.

chain.title: Wand Drills
chain.name: Hit a training dummy 5 times
chain.desc: The dummies in the courtyard never hit back. Left-click to cast; your spells hurt nothing inside the safe ground.

chain.title: Spiders at the Gate
chain.name: Defeat 6 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Leave the courtyard for the Village Outskirts or the Pitch Outskirts. Hit one spider and its pack answers - keep moving.

chain.title: Restless Dead
chain.name: Defeat 6 Inferi
chain.desc: Inferi stalk the Forest Edge past Hagrid's hut. Fire (Incendio) hurts them twice as much.

chain.title: Hagrid's Hut
chain.name: Report to Hagrid at his hut
chain.desc: Hagrid keeps watch over the forest from his hut west of the castle.

chain.title: Thinning the Brood
chain.name: Defeat 10 Acromantulas
chain.desc: The spiders breed faster than anyone can count. Greenhouse Meadow is crawling with them.

chain.title: Through the Great Doors
chain.name: Enter Hogwarts Castle
chain.desc: Walk up the castle approach and press F in the doorway to go inside.

chain.title: Your First Broom
chain.name: Collect your broom from Professor Flitwick
chain.desc: At level 5 every student gets a broom. Professor Flitwick waits at the castle approach.

chain.title: Quidditch Tryouts
chain.name: Fly to the Quidditch Pitch on your broom
chain.desc: Equip the broom, press Shift to mount, Space to rise and Ctrl to descend. Land on level ground and press Shift to dismount.

chain.title: Ash and Bone
chain.name: Defeat 12 Inferi
chain.desc: The Inferi gather again at the Forest Edge and in Greenhouse Meadow.

chain.title: Ollivander's Forge
chain.name: Speak with Ollivander
chain.desc: Ollivander works his anvil in the courtyard. He can make a wand stronger, at a price.

chain.title: A Stronger Wand
chain.name: Refine your wand once at Ollivander
chain.desc: Press O near Ollivander, drag your wand onto the anvil and refine it with Phoenix Ash and Galleons.

chain.title: The Eastern Road
chain.name: Defeat 12 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Merchants on the Eastern Road are turning back. Clear the spiders from the verges.

chain.title: Woven Magic
chain.name: Enchant an item at Ollivander
chain.desc: Put any piece of gear on the anvil and use an Imbue Scroll. A failed weave still spends the scroll.

chain.title: The Long Road Home
chain.name: Defeat 14 Inferi
chain.desc: Inferi wander onto the Eastern Road at dusk. Keep the road open.

chain.title: Acromantula Thicket
chain.name: Defeat 16 Acromantulas
chain.desc: West of the forest edge the spiders grow to the size of carts. Bring potions.

chain.title: Shatter the Darkness
chain.name: Help destroy a Dark Monolith
chain.desc: A purple beam marks a Dark Monolith. Join others and break it before its waves overrun you.

chain.title: The Trial Hall
chain.name: Complete the Trial Hall
chain.desc: Enter the Trial Hall from the courtyard portal, clear the corridor and defeat the Trial Warden.

chain.title: A Wand Worth Keeping
chain.name: Equip the Runebound Walnut Wand
chain.desc: Your new wand rolls a far higher Attack and Magic Attack Value. Equip it from your bag.

chain.title: Snatchers on the Road
chain.name: Defeat 10 Snatchers
chain.desc: Snatchers waylay travellers on the Hogsmeade Road. They cast back - keep your distance.

chain.title: The Three Broomsticks
chain.name: Speak with Madam Rosmerta in Hogsmeade
chain.desc: Fly east along the Hogsmeade Road. Madam Rosmerta knows every rumour in the valley.

chain.title: Pitch Woods
chain.name: Defeat 15 Acromantulas
chain.desc: The woods behind the Quidditch Pitch are thick with webs.

chain.title: Lakeside Glade
chain.name: Defeat 15 Inferi
chain.desc: Inferi crawl out of the Black Lake at the Lakeside Glade.

chain.title: Snatcher Woods
chain.name: Defeat 14 Snatchers
chain.desc: The snatchers have a camp in the woods south of the castle. Drive them out.

chain.title: Survey the Lake
chain.name: Visit the Lakeside Glade
chain.desc: Hagrid wants to know how far the Inferi have spread along the shore.

chain.title: Webs in the Glade
chain.name: Defeat 18 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Spiders and dead share the Lakeside Glade now. Clear the spiders first.

chain.title: Steel for the Road
chain.name: Refine any item twice
chain.desc: Ollivander can refine cloaks, accessories and brooms as well as wands.

chain.title: Breaking the Ring
chain.name: Defeat 18 Snatchers
chain.desc: Rosmerta has heard the snatchers answer to a captain. Weaken them before he moves.

chain.title: Crypt Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 18 Inferi
chain.desc: Deeper in the forest an old crypt has opened. The Inferi pour out of Crypt Hollow.

chain.title: Records of the Crypt
chain.name: Speak with Madam Pince
chain.desc: Madam Pince keeps the records of every grave on the grounds. She waits at the castle approach.

chain.title: Troll Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 6 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Forest trolls hit hard and slowly. Watch for the slam and step out of it.

chain.title: Sealing the Crypt
chain.name: Defeat 20 Inferi
chain.desc: Keep the Inferi in Crypt Hollow from reaching the forest paths.

chain.title: Dark Thicket
chain.name: Defeat 16 Snatchers
chain.desc: The snatchers fell back into the Dark Thicket, far to the west.

chain.title: Hollow Drums
chain.name: Defeat 10 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: The trolls beat drums every night. Silence them.

chain.title: Spider Woods
chain.name: Defeat 20 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Larger spiders hunt in the Spider Woods; something is feeding them.

chain.title: The Southern Barrows
chain.name: Defeat 22 Inferi
chain.desc: The barrows south of the lake have broken open.

chain.title: The Smugglers' Camp
chain.name: Scout the Smugglers' Camp
chain.desc: Find the snatcher captain's camp deep in the southern woods. Do not engage alone.

chain.title: The Snatcher Captain
chain.name: Defeat the captain at the Smugglers' Camp
chain.desc: Gather friends and defeat the Snatcher Captain in his camp.

chain.title: Last of the Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 10 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Without the snatchers' coin the trolls of the hollow will scatter. Finish them.

chain.title: Ridge Path
chain.name: Defeat 20 Snatchers
chain.desc: The captain's men fled up the Ridge Path. Hunt them down.

chain.title: Barrow Watch
chain.name: Defeat 24 Inferi
chain.desc: Hold the Southern Barrows while Madam Pince searches her records.

chain.title: Brood of the Woods
chain.name: Defeat 22 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Every spider in the Spider Woods answers to one mother.

chain.title: Crypt Gate
chain.name: Defeat 24 Inferi
chain.desc: The Crypt Gate to the west is the source. Thin the dead around it.

chain.title: Weaving for War
chain.name: Enchant items twice
chain.desc: Ollivander says no one should face the Matriarch with bare robes.

chain.title: Ridge Ambush
chain.name: Defeat 22 Snatchers
chain.desc: The snatchers ambush anyone who climbs the Ridge Path.

chain.title: The Matriarch's Guard
chain.name: Defeat 26 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Clear the spiders that guard the way to Spider Hollow.

chain.title: Spider Hollow
chain.name: Find Spider Hollow
chain.desc: The Matriarch nests in Spider Hollow in the far north-west.

chain.title: The Matriarch
chain.name: Defeat the Acromantula Matriarch
chain.desc: Bring a party. The Matriarch's bite poisons and her brood answers her call.

chain.title: Gate of Bones
chain.name: Defeat 26 Inferi
chain.desc: With the Matriarch gone, Madam Pince can finally seal the Crypt Gate.

chain.title: The Forge's Fire
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: The moors are harder still. Ollivander will not let you go up there half-made.

chain.title: Western Moor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Forest trolls have climbed onto the Western Moor.

chain.title: Moorland Orders
chain.name: Speak with Professor Flitwick
chain.desc: Flitwick is organising the students who go up to the moors.

chain.title: Trolls on the Heath
chain.name: Defeat 12 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Push the forest trolls off the Western Moor.

chain.title: Hogsmeade Heights
chain.name: Defeat 22 Snatchers
chain.desc: The heights above Hogsmeade are crawling with dark wizards.

chain.title: Watchers on the Heights
chain.name: Defeat 24 Snatchers
chain.desc: They are watching the village. Make them stop.

chain.title: Clearing the Heights
chain.name: Defeat 26 Snatchers
chain.desc: One last push and Hogsmeade can sleep again.

chain.title: The Highland Moor
chain.name: Reach the Highland Moor
chain.desc: Mountain trolls have been seen on the Highland Moor, north of the pitch.

chain.title: Mountain Trolls
chain.name: Defeat 8 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Mountain trolls throw boulders as well as fists. Keep moving.

chain.title: Boulder Throwers
chain.name: Defeat 10 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Every troll you fell is one less marching on the castle.

chain.title: Out of Bounds
chain.name: Speak with Madam Pince about the third floor
chain.desc: Madam Pince has found a note: the third-floor corridor is out of bounds - and guarded.

chain.title: Pests of the Third Floor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Cornish Pixies
chain.desc: Enter the Forbidden Corridor from the castle. The pixies swarm and lift you off your feet.

chain.title: Living Armour
chain.name: Defeat 8 Suits of Armour
chain.desc: Enchanted suits of armour guard the corridor. Force spells shake them apart.

chain.title: The Cursed Commander
chain.name: Defeat the Cursed Commander
chain.desc: The commander of the armour stands at the corridor's first gate.

chain.title: Devil's Snare
chain.name: Burn the root of the Devil's Snare
chain.desc: Fire is the answer. Burn the vines, then the root.

chain.title: More Pixies
chain.name: Defeat 16 Cornish Pixies
chain.desc: The pixies on the stairs beyond the snare are worse than the first lot.

chain.title: The Three-Headed Dog
chain.name: Defeat Fluffy
chain.desc: Use the harp to lull the heads to sleep, then strike while they doze.

chain.title: The Corridor Cleared
chain.name: Complete the Forbidden Corridor
chain.desc: Run the corridor from the pixies to the trapdoor in one go.

chain.title: A Wand for the Storm
chain.name: Speak with Ollivander
chain.desc: Ollivander has finished a wand worthy of what comes next.

chain.title: Eastern Moor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Grak's trolls hold the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: Grak's Allies
chain.name: Defeat 26 Snatchers
chain.desc: Dark wizards march with the trolls on the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: The Troll Muster
chain.name: Defeat 14 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Break the muster before it reaches the summit.

chain.title: Storm Riders
chain.name: Defeat 28 Snatchers
chain.desc: The dark wizards ride the storm clouds over the moor.

chain.title: Phoenix Weave
chain.name: Enchant items three times
chain.desc: A Phoenix Regalia deserves its weave. Make the most of it.

chain.title: Stone Circle Summit
chain.name: Climb to the Stone Circle Summit
chain.desc: Grak, the Mountain Troll Chieftain, waits at the summit.

chain.title: Grak the Chieftain
chain.name: Defeat Grak, Mountain Troll Chieftain
chain.desc: Grak only appears every so often. Gather a party and be ready.

chain.title: Scattering the Clans
chain.name: Defeat 16 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Without their chieftain the clans fight among themselves. Finish them.

chain.title: Deserters
chain.name: Defeat 28 Snatchers
chain.desc: The dark wizards who marched with Grak are fleeing across the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: Monolith on the Moor
chain.name: Help destroy a Dark Monolith
chain.desc: A Dark Monolith has risen where Grak fell. Break it with others.

chain.title: Masterwork
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: Dementors are coming. Ollivander wants every piece you own at its best.

chain.title: Expecto Patronum
chain.name: Speak with Professor Fig about the Patronus
chain.desc: Professor Fig can teach you the Patronus Charm (level 40). Dementors fear nothing else.

chain.title: The Misty Shore
chain.name: Defeat 10 Dementors
chain.desc: Dementors drift in from the Misty Shore. Their aura stops your health from recovering.

chain.title: Station Mist
chain.name: Defeat 12 Dementors
chain.desc: The old station is lost in the mist.

chain.title: Cold Platform
chain.name: Defeat 12 more Dementors
chain.desc: Hold the platform until the mist lifts.

chain.title: Shoreline Vigil
chain.name: Defeat 14 Dementors
chain.desc: Keep the Misty Shore clear for the boats.

chain.title: Warmth Against the Cold
chain.name: Enchant items three times
chain.desc: Ollivander has a theory about weaves that resist despair.

chain.title: Fog Barrens
chain.name: Defeat 14 Dementors
chain.desc: South of the castle the Fog Barrens have swallowed the road.

chain.title: Into the Fog
chain.name: Reach the Fog Barrens
chain.desc: Mark the edge of the fog so the others can follow.

chain.title: Shades of the Barrens
chain.name: Defeat 16 Dementors
chain.desc: The deeper you go, the colder it gets.

chain.title: Lights in the Fog
chain.name: Defeat 16 more Dementors
chain.desc: Every Patronus you cast lights the way for someone else.

chain.title: Grey Marsh
chain.name: Defeat 16 Dementors
chain.desc: The Grey Marsh is where the mist begins.

chain.title: The Last Polish
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: Ollivander wants one more look at your gear before the end.

chain.title: Marsh Wardens
chain.name: Defeat 18 Dementors
chain.desc: Dementors circle a barrow at the far end of the marsh.

chain.title: Breaking the Circle
chain.name: Defeat 18 more Dementors
chain.desc: Break their circle and the barrow is exposed.

chain.title: The Cold Heart
chain.name: Defeat 20 Dementors
chain.desc: Something at the heart of the marsh calls them.

chain.title: Warden's Barrow
chain.name: Find Warden's Barrow
chain.desc: The Azkaban Warden sleeps in a barrow in the marsh.

chain.title: Before the Storm
chain.name: Defeat 22 Dementors
chain.desc: Clear the way to the barrow for your party.

chain.title: Final Preparations
chain.name: Speak with Professor Fig
chain.desc: Professor Fig has one last piece of advice before you face the Warden.

chain.title: The Azkaban Warden
chain.name: Defeat the Azkaban Warden
chain.desc: Gather your strongest friends. The Warden drains hope itself.

chain.title: Graduation
chain.name: Report your victory to Professor Fig
chain.desc: The valley is safe - for now. Professor Fig is waiting to congratulate you.
